Third-party browser libraries, self-hosted (nothing loads from a public CDN). Copied unchanged from npm.

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xlsx.full.min.js` | xlsx (SheetJS Community Edition) | 0.18.5 | Apache-2.0 |
| `jspdf.umd.min.js` | jspdf | 2.5.1 | MIT |
| `jszip.min.js` | jszip | 3.10.1 | MIT or GPL-3.0 |

These are the same versions the existing apps loaded from cdnjs. Used by the Scheduler's exports (and Fee Builder's Excel export).
